# EKO Perspectives project instructions

When working on any EKO Perspectives post or editorial task in this repository, first read `.editorial/EKO_EDITORIAL_WORKFLOW_v2.3.md` and follow the stage routing inside it. Also consult `.editorial/story-engine-library.md` for story structure and `.editorial/EKO_PERSPECTIVES_EDITORIAL_PLAN.md` for the standing topic bank, site priorities and longer-horizon planning.

The repository's **EKO Editorial Workflow v2.3** is authoritative and supersedes v2.2 and the older separate `pre2015-prose-voice` and `ai-slop-editing-pass` workflow. If a planning-reference file contains an older or more rigid instruction, v2.3 wins.

Do not publish or modify published posts without explicit owner approval. New posts stay `draft: true`. Preserve the workflow's planning, evidence, rebuttal, story-engine, voice, anti-slop, image, SEO/discovery and rendered-page QA stages in their stated order. SEO is packaging, not a writing brief.

There is no single E360 formula and no single pre-2015 research-blog formula. Choose structure after evidence is understood, never invent reporting access or scenes, and use first person only for something Elvis actually did, observed, modelled, read, decided, experienced or believes.

Every published post needs at least one relevant lead image stored locally with descriptive alt text and any required credit or licence. A second image is used only when it adds genuine explanatory, documentary or historical value; do not add decorative stock filler.
